استفهما (form X)

# اُسْتُفْهِمَا (ustufhimā) /us.tuf.hi.maː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِسْتَفْهَمَ (istafhama)
# اِسْتَفْهِمَا (istafhimā) /is.taf.hi.maː/: second-person dual imperative of اِسْتَفْهَمَ (istafhama)
